module_summary: AXI4 to AXI-lite write adapter: a 4-state FSM accepts AXI write bursts, tracks address/beat count, splits or merges data width, issues one AXI-lite write per beat and returns one merged response.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/DATA/DATA_2/RESP controller sequencing address accept, data transfer and response collection

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave write-address valid; starts a new burst in IDLE

anchors.name: s_axi_awready
anchors.why: Slave write-address ready from s_axi_awready_reg, asserted in IDLE

anchors.name: s_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Slave write-data valid; accepted beats advance burst and address

anchors.name: s_axi_wready
anchors.why: Slave write-data ready from s_axi_wready_reg, gated by master wvalid

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data beats copied, replicated or packed into AXI-lite write data

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Burst start address loaded into addr_reg and master awaddr

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Slave write-response valid raised when burst finishes in RESP

anchors.name: s_axi_bresp
anchors.why: Merged response: first or any error AXI-lite bresp of the burst

anchors.name: m_axil_awaddr
anchors.why: AXI-lite write address per single transfer, from awaddr or addr_reg

anchors.name: m_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI-lite address valid issued for each transfer, cleared on awready

anchors.name: m_axil_wdata
anchors.why: AXI-lite write data, shifted/replicated/merged from slave write data

anchors.name: m_axil_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI-lite write-data valid, gates slave wready

anchors.name: m_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: AXI-lite response valid; completes a transfer in RESP

anchors.name: m_axil_bready
anchors.why: AXI-lite response ready, asserted when slave response channel free

anchors.name: addr_reg
anchors.why: Current burst address, incremented per beat; feeds next awaddr and lane shifts

anchors.name: burst_reg
anchors.why: Remaining beat count loaded from awlen, decremented per accepted beat

anchors.name: burst_active_reg
anchors.why: Burst still active; decides RESP returns to DATA or finishes to IDLE

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: Wide data held while splitting or merging across segments

anchors.name: strb_reg
anchors.why: Write strobes held alongside data_reg for split/merge

anchors.name: id_reg
anchors.why: Latched AXI write ID returned on bid

anchors.name: burst_size_reg
anchors.why: Latched awsize controlling address increment per beat

anchors.name: master_burst_size_reg
anchors.why: Output transfer size used for address stepping and merge boundary

anchors.name: convert_burst_reg
anchors.why: Selects merge path STATE_DATA_2 vs narrow pass-through after response

anchors.name: first_transfer_reg
anchors.why: Marks first transfer so its bresp is captured

anchors.name: last_segment_reg
anchors.why: Last narrow segment of a split beat; chooses DATA vs DATA_2

groups.name: Write FSM
groups.description: Sequences address accept, data beats, per-transfer response and burst completion

groups.name: Burst tracking
groups.description: Beat counter and address/size/ID holding registers for the active burst

groups.name: Width conversion datapath
groups.description: Splits, replicates or merges slave data and strobes into AXI-lite write data

groups.name: AXI slave write port
groups.description: AXI4 AW/W/B channels with registered ready and response outputs

groups.name: AXI-lite master write port
groups.description: Registered AXI-lite AW/W outputs and B response handshake
